chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:
I asked him (peace be upon him) about two women who are found in one quilt. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Each one of them should be whipped one hundred lashes'.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal penalty for lesbianism according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This narration from Sam'a ibn Mihran, a prominent jurist in the Shia tradition, establishes the hadd penalty of one hundred lashes for female same-sex intercourse (liwat al-nisa) based on the physical evidence of intimacy under a single covering. It reflects the classical juristic consensus that the penalty for this act mirrors that of heterosexual zina, emphasizing the evidentiary standard of cohabitation or close physical contact as proof of the act.
